title: agentcap - AI agent activity
description: AI-agent process-tree activity captured by the agentcap eBPF exporter (yeet).

panels.title: Which agent ran what (session)
panels.description: Tool launches per agent, cumulative since the exporter started.

panels.title: Domains queried by agent
panels.description: Cumulative since exporter start. Plaintext DNS (port 53) and nss-resolved lookups; DoH/DoT are not visible.

panels.title: Destination ports by agent
panels.description: Well-known ports are named and green/amber; unrecognized or risky ports (telnet, rdp) show red.

panels.title: Files opened by agent
panels.description: Regular files opened per agent (writes always kept; noisy read-only system/library paths filtered out).

panels.title: CPU share by agent
panels.description: On-CPU time split across agents over the range.

panels.title: Tool launches by agent (range)
panels.description: Total execs each agent tree performed.

panels.title: Agent active / idle timeline
panels.description: Green where the agent tree had a live task.

panels.title: CPU cores in use by agent (now)
panels.description: Per-agent CPU as a fraction of one core.

panels.title: Fleet activity clock
panels.description: Exec + connect rate bucketed over time — when the fleet is busy vs. quiet.

panels.title: Per-agent load band
panels.description: One row per agent; cells colored idle / light / busy / heavy from CPU cores in use.
